7,662 likes, 37 comments - petermckinnon on August 13, 2026: "Dressing room hangs with my bro @julius_son // We’ve got a few of these under our belts now- we’re always scheming something! Feels good to be creative with creative people. 

The post-show airway humidifier is always my fav. You can see my excitement 😂😂 I have collected many over the years. 🤿 

Portra 400 looked smooth and warm with the lights in this room. Very happy. When you have a friend with style like JJ, takin’ pics is eassssyyyyy.".
